scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.play: GAME_PORT=4555 concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "PORT=4555 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --port 5555 --strictPort"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test:performance-closure: node --import tsx scripts/test-tile-scheduler.ts && node --import tsx scripts/test-detail-worker.ts && node --import tsx scripts/test-lod-parity.ts && node --max-old-space-size=10240 --import tsx scripts/test-tilekeys.ts
